subject: Next steps & mutual action plan — HealthCore buying process
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Emily Jones <emily.jones@healthcore.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@healthcore.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps from today's discovery — buying criteria & MAP draft

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Key points from today's discovery:
- Primary use case: inference for clinical summarization (batch + near-real-time).
- Decision criteria you highlighted: latency under ~200ms for priority endpoints, clear data residency, SOC 2 evidence, and predictable unit cost to model token volume.
- Main stakeholders: Sandra Miller (VP Product) is the economic decision maker; Raj Patel will lead procurement/legal intake.
- Timeline: target procurement & PO by end of July / early August to start a Sep PoC.

Immediate asks from HealthCore:
1) Confirm economic buyer and procurement contact (I recorded Sandra and Raj above).
2) Share SOC 2 attestation and any redlines procurement requires.
3) Confirm top performance metric (latency vs cost tradeoff) you want us to optimize for in the PoC.

Attached: SOW-draft-v1.docx (starter scope) and a redacted SOC2-report-2026.pdf we can share as evidence.

Suggested mutual action plan (draft):
- Jul 14: Share draft SOW and SOC2 (Redwood) — owner: Hannah (done, attached).
- Jul 20: HealthCore to provide procurement intake form + redlines — owner: Raj / procurement@healthcore.com.
- Jul 25: Legal/security sync (if needed) to resolve data residency and logging requirements — owners: HealthCore security & Redwood technical lead.
- Aug 01: Finalize commercial terms (PO/contract) — owners: Sandra + Jordan (Redwood).
- Sep 06: PoC kickoff (technical onboarding) — owners: HealthCore engineering + Redwood CS.

Can you confirm the timeline and whether we should prioritize latency or cost for the PoC? If you approve, we'll convert the draft into a firmer MAP with owners and target dates.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW-draft-v1.docx (attachment stub), SOC2-report-2026.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Emily Jones <emily.jones@healthcore.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@healthcore.com>, Sandra Miller <sandra.miller@healthcore.com>
Date: 2027-07-14T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps from today's discovery — buying criteria & MAP draft

Hannah —

Thanks for the clear recap. This matches our notes. A few clarifications:
- Confirmed: Sandra Miller is the economic buyer and will sign the PO. She is cc'd here.
- Procurement lead is Raj (cc'd). Our procurement team prefers to handle redlines via a single consolidated .docx; procurement@healthcore.com is the intake address.
- Timeline: we're aiming to have commercial terms agreed by the first week of August; procurement needs internal approval windows which can slip, but we'll push.

On priorities: for the PoC our product team wants to validate latency for the 99th percentile at 512 tokens — please design the PoC to show tail latency. Cost is important but secondary for the initial run.

Can you also send the SOC2 attestation and a short security appendix that outlines data handling and logging (we'll need it for our InfoSec review)?

Thanks — I'll coordinate procurement intake and get back with the onboarding form by Jul 20.

Emily Jones
Director, AI Platforms
HealthCore Labs

1) Jordan will prepare two pricing scenarios (latency-optimized vs cost-optimized) and a short commentary on throughput/VM sizing.
2) Marissa will draft a 30-day onboarding and enablement plan for the PoC.

If that looks right, I'll upload the MAP to the shared Drive and convert it to a checklist that locks in owners and dates.

Best,
